mapper.insert: insert into follow (user_id, follower_id, time) values (#{userId}, #{followerId}, #{time})
mapper.delete: delete from follow where user_id = #{userId} and follower_id = #{followerId}
mapper.select: select * from follow where user_id = #{userId} and follower_id = #{followerId}

select u.id, u.username, u.name, u.avatar, u.info, (select count(*) from follow f2 where f2.user_id = u.id and f2.follower_id = #{currentUserId}) as isFollowed from follow f left join user u on f.follower_id = u.id where f.user_id = #{userId} order by f.id desc
